description: How a vehicle uses and pays for its energy. Electric: consumption per 100 km, price per kWh, energy cost per 100 km, charging efficiency, cost of a full charge, the mix of slow, AC and DC charging with the price of each, the effect of cold weather, the usable capacity and the battery state of health. Fuel: litres per 100 km, price per litre, fuel cost per 100 km. The basis field says which electric figures are measured and which are derived.

description: What owning a vehicle really costs once the purchase counts, which get_vehicle_costs leaves out: the full cost and its cost per kilometre (running costs with the tires amortized, plus the depreciation), the lease or loan with its mileage allowance used and the projected excess cost, and the estimated resale value today. Check depreciation_known before comparing the full cost of two vehicles: when false, the depreciation is missing and the full cost is understated.

title: Vehicle ownership cost

description: The individual entries behind a vehicle's costs, one per charge, fuel fill-up, toll, maintenance or insurance expense, tire purchase or loan or lease instalment, with their date, category, amount and, for a charge, the place and the energy. Filter by period, category and minimum amount, sort by date or amount. The total and the per-category sums cover every matching entry, not only the page, so never add up the page yourself. The purchase of the vehicle is not an entry. Use it to answer which expense was the largest, what was spent on a category in a period or where the vehicle was charged.

ascending.description: oldest or smallest first instead of newest or largest first

categories.description: keep only these categories: energy, toll, parking, travel_other, maintenance, repair, insurance, subscription, tax, financing, tires, accessory, other; every running cost when omitted

from.description: first day to include, YYYY-MM-DD; no lower bound when omitted

limit.description: entries per page, 50 by default, 200 at most

min_amount.description: keep only the entries of at least this amount, a decimal string such as 50.00, in the vehicle's currency

to.description: last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD; no upper bound when omitted
